body:
I was desperate to get high. I heard about opiates like oxycontin and morphine, but didn't find anything around my house except prescription Lexapro. I looked that up but didn't find anything psychoactive about it.
Then, one night I went into my dad's bathroom to weigh myself and I opened his medicine cabinet to find to bottles of prescribed Hydrocodone. My jaw dropped I snuck a few pills one day and went to mcdonalds for a free mini-cup (since I didn't have any money on me). On my way there I found a lighter and after getting a drink in my cup, I smoked 2 half smoked cigarettes (tiny ashes got into my drink). I added the pills into my drink. I drank it down and had to swallow almost dissolved pills.
I waited for half an hour but I didn't  feel anything so I went back home. Then it hit me, and boy, was I having serious nausea. After about an hour it calmed down, and now I feel a little light headed I guess. Oh well I'm still on my quest I suppose.
